headline: Annual growth holds, sequential momentum fades
summary_short: Revenue was $448.5M, up 5.7% y/y but down 22.8% q/q; diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 19.1% y/y while falling 41.4% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue was $448.5M, up 5.7% y/y but down 22.8% q/q. Gross margin was about 53.0%, down roughly 44bp y/y and about flat q/q. Diluted EPS of $1.56 rose 19.1% y/y but fell 41.4% q/q; net income of $81.8M was up 14.8% y/y and down 41.7% q/q. Total cash was $800.9M, up 48.4% y/y and 2.9% q/q; shareholders' equity rose to $2,128.0M, up 9.2% y/y and 1.2% q/q.
